title: Operations Administrator
description:
Operations Administrator

Manchester 25,000 - 28,000 Hybrid working: 4 days office, 1 day from home

MFK Recruitment is delighted to be recruiting an Operations Administrator for a highly respected organisation based in Manchester.

We have recruited 7 people into the organisation over the past three and a half years, and all seven are still there. That speaks volumes about the culture, leadership, stability and quality of the working environment.

This is a great opportunity for someone with administration, operations or logistics experience who wants to join a supportive and well-established organisation where their work genuinely has an impact.

The Role

As Operations Administrator, you will provide administrative and operational support across a wide range of activities.

A key part of the role will involve supporting the planning and delivery of sample distributions to laboratories internationally, so previous logistics, shipping or distribution experience would be particularly useful.

You will also support customers, manage administrative systems, coordinate meetings and events, maintain accurate records and assist with quality management activities.

There will be a one-month handover period with the current postholder to help you settle into the role.

Key Responsibilities
- Support the planning and coordination of sample distributions to laboratories worldwide
- Organise shipping, packing and courier arrangements
- Communicate with customers, suppliers, agents and other external stakeholders
- Monitor customer support tickets and respond to or delegate queries appropriately
- Maintain customer accounts, registrations and participation records
- Liaise with suppliers and raise purchase orders where required
- Support stock control and general office operations
- Assist with sample packing and data loading
- Support document control, audits and non-conformance activities within the Quality Management System
- Take accurate meeting minutes when required
- Help improve administrative processes and systems
- Manage your own workload and priorities while working closely with the Operations Manager

About You

We are looking for someone organised, reliable and comfortable managing several different tasks at the same time.

You should have:
- Previous administration, operations or logistics experience
- Strong organisational and time-management skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Confident written and verbal communication skills
- Good customer service skills
- Strong computer literacy, including Microsoft Office
- The ability to maintain accurate records and work with data
- A proactive approach to solving problems and improving processes
- The confidence to communicate with customers, suppliers and colleagues at all levels

Experience involving logistics, shipping, couriers, distributions or stock control would be particularly advantageous.

Experience within healthcare, laboratories, life sciences, quality management or another regulated environment would be beneficial but is not essential.

Why Join?
- Salary of 25,000 - 28,000
- Excellent benefits package, including a generous NHS-matched pension scheme
- Hybrid working with 4 days in the Manchester office and 1 day from home each week
- One-month handover with the current postholder
- Excellent staff retention and a stable working environment
- Supportive and collaborative team culture
- Varied role combining administration, operations, logistics and customer support

title: Business Support Administrator
description:
Business Support Administrator - Manchester (M1)
Company and Role Overview

V7 Recruitment is a Manchester-based recruitment agency specialising in Engineering and Technical industries across the UK and Europe.

We have grown quickly by challenging how recruitment has traditionally been done, and we need someone equally driven to help keep that growth moving.
This is not a background administrative role where every day looks the same.

As a Team Administrator, you will sit at the centre of a fast-moving recruitment business, coordinating international travel, managing assignment documentation, resolving candidate queries and ensuring the details behind every placement are handled properly.

You will work closely with our Senior Leadership Team, consultants, candidates and internal departments, often becoming the person people rely on when something needs organising, answering or fixing.

The role would suit someone who enjoys responsibility, communicates confidently and takes pride in staying one step ahead.

Key Responsibilities
- Travel and Accommodation Coordination: Organise flights, accommodation and travel arrangements for candidates working across the UK and Europe, responding quickly when plans change.
- Assignment Administration: Coordinate assignment schedules and documentation, ensuring candidates and internal teams have the correct information at the right time.
- Contract Support: Assist with contracts and act as a point of contact for contract-related questions.
- Payroll and Expense Queries: Support candidates with payroll and expense queries, working with the relevant internal teams to resolve issues accurately and efficiently.
- Tracking and Reporting: Maintain expense trackers, assignment records and administrative systems, ensuring information remains accurate and up to date.
- Candidate Support: Support candidates before and throughout their assignments, providing a reliable point of contact when they need guidance.
- Inbound Call Handling: Handle incoming calls with confidence and professionalism, resolving queries where possible or directing them to the right person.
- Senior Leadership Support: Provide responsive administrative support to the Senior Leadership Team and help ensure the wider business continues to run smoothly.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who does more than wait for the next task.
You will be proactive, organised and comfortable taking ownership in an environment where priorities can move quickly.

You will also have:
- Previous experience in an administrative, operations or business support role.
- Experience maintaining trackers, records and administrative systems.
- A confident and professional telephone manner.
- Strong organisational skills and close attention to detail.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills.
- The ability to prioritise competing tasks without losing sight of the detail.
- Confidence dealing with candidates and responding to contract, payroll and expense queries.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other administrative software.
- A practical, collaborative approach and the confidence to solve problems independently.
- Experience within recruitment or another fast-paced, service-led business would be beneficial, but attitude, organisation and ownership are just as important.

Why Join V7?
- You will be joining an ambitious business where good ideas are listened to, responsibility is encouraged and people are trusted to make an impact.
- This is an opportunity to take ownership of a varied role, work closely with senior leaders and become a key part of how V7 operates as the business continues to grow.

Working Conditions
- This position is based in our Manchester office.
- Working hours are 08:30-17:30 Monday to Thursday and 08:30-16:00 on Friday, with the option to work from home on Wednesday.

How to Apply

Ready to take ownership of a role where your work genuinely keeps the business moving?

title: Lettings Administrator
description:
Resident Lettings Administrator / Resident Contracts Executive

Manchester City Centre £27,000 + £2,000 Bonus Monday-Friday

Looking to start a career in property?

If you're organised, hard-working and ambitious, and have a genuine interest in building a career within the property industry, this could be the opportunity you've been looking for.

We're recruiting for a global property group with a fantastic culture, exciting residential brands and an excellent reputation for developing its people.

This is an entry-level opportunity designed for someone who wants to learn, develop and build a long-term career within property.

Previous experience in property, lettings, estate agency or residential accommodation would certainly be beneficial - but it isn't essential.

What's more important is your genuine interest in property, your attitude and your ability to work in an organised, structured and accurate way.

The Opportunity

You'll join the team responsible for the administration behind the resident journey, helping ensure everything is in place from application through to move-in and throughout the tenancy.

It's a busy, admin-focused position where attention to detail is key. You'll work closely with Sales and Operations while learning about tenancy agreements, referencing, compliance, rental payments and the wider residential property operation.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Preparing tenancy agreements and licences
- Carrying out tenant referencing and Right to Rent checks
- Ensuring contracts, documentation and payments are completed before move-in
- Maintaining accurate resident, tenancy and CRM records
- Managing rent schedules and payment reconciliation
- Investigating payment queries and discrepancies
- Monitoring outstanding rental payments
- Supporting tenancy and debt management administration
- Liaising with residents, solicitors, councils and external partners
- Supporting the wider Sales and Operations teams

Who Are We Looking For?

You don't need years of experience. We're looking for someone with the right attitude and a genuine desire to develop a career in property.

You'll ideally be:
- Highly organised and structured in the way you work
- Hard-working, reliable and willing to learn
- Someone who enjoys an administration-based role
- Accurate with excellent attention to detail
- Comfortable managing several tasks and deadlines
- Confident communicating with customers and colleagues
- Proactive and happy taking responsibility for your workload
- Genuinely interested in property and residential living
- Ambitious to learn, develop and progress

You could be a graduate or early-career professional, or perhaps you're already working within administration, customer service, finance, lettings or estate agency and want to establish yourself within the property industry.

Why This Opportunity?

This isn't just about finding your next admin job.

It's an opportunity to get your foot in the door of the property industry with a successful global organisation where you'll gain valuable experience, learn how a major residential property business operates and have the opportunity to develop your career as the company continues to grow.

You'll receive:
- £27,000 basic salary + £2,000 bonus opportunity
- Monday-Friday, 08:30-17:00
- 22 days holiday, increasing to 25 days with service
- Perkbox with 250+ discounts, perks and wellbeing benefits
- Excellent training and development
- Genuine opportunities for long-term career progression
- A fantastic working culture within a growing global property group

If you're organised, ambitious and serious about starting a career in property, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Credit Hire Claims Handler
description:
Credit Hire Claims Handler

Manchester City Centre Office Based
Monday to Friday 08:30am - 5:00pm
£28,000 - £35,000 DOE

MPJ Recruitment are delighted to be working with a well-established and expanding insurance organisation who are looking to strengthen their claims team with an experienced Credit Hire Claims Handler.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with a background in Credit Hire who wants to join a professional, supportive environment where you can manage your own caseload, build on your existing technical knowledge and progress your career within the insurance sector.

If you're confident handling Credit Hire claims and enjoy working on cases where investigation, negotiation and commercial decision-making are key, this could be an excellent next move.

The Opportunity

Joining an established claims team, you will take responsibility for a portfolio of Credit Hire claims, managing cases from initial notification through to successful resolution.

You'll deal with a wide range of stakeholders including claimants, solicitors, insurers and accident management companies, using your knowledge and negotiation skills to achieve appropriate and commercially viable settlements.

Key Responsibilities
- Take ownership of a caseload of Credit Hire claims from notification through to settlement.
- Investigate claims and establish liability, indemnity and overall claim position.
- Assess the validity and reasonableness of Credit Hire claims.
- Negotiate settlements with solicitors, insurers and other third parties.
- Challenge areas including hire duration, rates, need and impecuniosity where appropriate.
- Review statements, invoices, hire agreements and other supporting documentation.
- Identify opportunities to control and minimise claims expenditure.
- Proactively manage disputed, complex and high-value claims.
- Maintain accurate and comprehensive claims records.
- Ensure claims are handled in accordance with internal procedures, industry standards and regulatory requirements.
- Recognise and escalate potential fraud or suspicious activity.
- Maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
- Deliver a professional and efficient service throughout the claims journey.

About You

We're looking for someone who already has experience within Credit Hire claims and is comfortable managing their own caseload.

Ideally, you'll have:
- Previous experience handling Credit Hire claims.
- A solid understanding of Credit Hire processes and principles.
- Knowledge of liability, indemnity and claims investigation.
- Experience negotiating settlements and dealing with disputed claims.
- The ability to confidently challenge costs and identify opportunities for mitigation.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent organisation and time-management skills.
- A proactive and commercially aware approach.
- The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a wider team.

Experience within insurance, claims, legal, credit hire or accident management environments would be highly beneficial!

What's On Offer
- £28,000 - £35,000 salary, depending on experience
- 33 days annual leave
- Fully paid training
- Regular salary reviews
- Company pension scheme
- Clear opportunities for career progression
- Company social events
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Modern Manchester City Centre offices

Interested?

If you're an experienced Credit Hire Claims Handler looking for a new challenge with a growing organisation that offers genuine opportunities to develop, we'd love to hear from you.

Previous receptionist or customer service experience is desirable, although full training will be provided. At Boothstown Medical Centre, we pride ourselves on delivering compassionate, patient-centred care within a welcoming and forward-thinking practice. We have a strong team culture where every member of staff is valued and supported, and we are committed to staff wellbeing, professional development and continuous improvement. This is an excellent opportunity to join a friendly and dedicated team making a real difference to the local community every day. If you are organised, approachable and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, we would love to hear from you. They will be responsible for assisting patients in accessing the appropriate healthcare professional or service, responding to enquiries, and supporting the smooth day-to-day operation of the practice. The successful candidate will work closely with the wider practice team to deliver high standards of customer service, maintain accurate patient records, and contribute to a positive patient experience. They will represent the practice in a courteous, compassionate and professional manner, both face-to-face and over the telephone. Develop and maintain a thorough knowledge of practice procedures and services. Work in accordance with practice policies, protocols and confidentiality requirements. Undertake routine administrative tasks, including photocopying, scanning and document management. Open, process and distribute incoming post as appropriate. Liaise effectively with hospitals, community services and other healthcare professionals. Register new patients and ensure accurate completion of registration documentation. Support the wider practice team with general administrative duties as required. Welcome and assist patients and visitors attending the practice. Respond to patient enquiries promptly, efficiently and sensitively. Manage patient interactions at the reception desk while maintaining confidentiality at all times. Issue completed repeat prescriptions in accordance with practice procedures, ensuring patient details are verified. Provide cover across all reception workstations as required. Prepare pathology specimens and arrange collection by the designated courier. Distribute internal correspondence and documentation. Process patient appointment requests via telephone, online systems and face-to-face enquiries. Book, amend and cancel appointments in accordance with practice protocols. Manage requests for home visits and ensure they are directed appropriately. Record and process telephone consultation requests accurately within the clinical system. Signpost patients to the most appropriate service or healthcare professional. Register new patients and maintain accurate electronic patient records. Process changes to patient demographic information in a timely manner. Manage repeat prescription requests in accordance with practice policies. Scan, file and code clinical correspondence using the practice document management system. Accurately enter clinical and non-clinical data onto patient records. Update patient information, including smoking status, weight and other Quality and Outcomes Framework (QOF) data. Act upon relevant alerts and notifications within the clinical system. Record patient contacts and communications accurately. Complete patient details on pathology request forms as required. Answer incoming telephone calls promptly and professionally. This role requires excellent communication, organisational and customer service skills, together with the ability to work effectively within a busy multidisciplinary team whilst maintaining patient confidentiality at all times.
